title: Small Models for Brev's Generative Tier
summary: We ran four small models (1.7B–4B) against Brev's generative tier on the same 1,960-row classification arm. The 4B models tie at ~84%; the 1.7B LFM3 collapses to 12%. The current 4B tiers stay.
eyebrow: Brev research · generative tier · small-model comparison
